data.name: Boy Escape from School
data.detailed_description:
This summer, Schoolboy has already pulled off several grand escapes – first from his grandparents’ village, then from that dreadful summer camp. But freedom didn’t last long: his parents sent him back to school again. And, as always, trouble wasn’t far behind. After accidentally smashing a window with a ball, the kid was left alone in an empty classroom after lessons as punishment. But does he really have to sit there quietly? No way! The Boy is dead set on staging yet another breakout – his signature style!

School Atmosphere

Noisy hallways, locked classrooms, the principal’s office, the creepy basement, and even the gym – every room hides secrets. Clues, keys, and essential items might be tucked behind doors or under desks. The school adventure atmosphere makes each level engaging and unpredictable.

Puzzles and Challenges

This game is a true point-and-click quest blended with adventure. Expect hidden object searches, code-breaking, cipher decryption, logic puzzles, and much more…

Humor and Hilarious Situations

The Boy’s school escape isn’t just action – it’s also packed with fun! Amusing items, funny dialogues, and unexpected scenarios will definitely bring a smile to your face and make your playthrough even more enjoyable.

Hidden Areas and Secret Objects

If you love hidden-object games, you’re in for a treat. Some items are so well concealed that only the most observant players will spot them. Can you uncover all the school’s secrets and collect everything needed for the escape?

Diverse Characters

Students, teachers, the gym coach, the janitor, bullies, the ghost of an old writer… and that’s not even the full list! Character dialogues are truly unique, and punishments from teachers and other staff members are harsh and unforgiving!

Multiple Escape Routes

Like other games in the series, this installment offers several ways to escape – from the obvious (just walking out the front door) to the wildly creative (like crafting your own flying machine). Which escape route will you choose?

If you’re a fan of Boy Escape games, quests, and brain-teasing puzzles, this chapter will quickly become your new favorite. Test your attentiveness and wit – help The Boy escape once again! Add the game to your wishlist; it’s coming soon! The Steam version features enhanced graphics, increased draw distance, a brand-new ending, and Steam Achievements!
